summary: Even before his arrival in New York, Trump has cast a shadow over the Australian PM’s visit. title: Dubai’s Up to $381 Million ALEC Contractor IPO Sells Out
summary: Dubai had demand for all shares on offer in an up to $381 million initial public offering of ALEC Engineering & Contracting LLC, marking the emirate’s latest push to privatize assets and capitalize on a construction boom in the Middle East.
